answer: With a Translation bundle accepted by the project lead backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the translation bundle is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The design treats each contribution as a vertex: small alone, decisive in aggregate. Between a orchard and a basalt lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to mint but expensive to employ.
